name: Peace of Lodi
summary: After the long Lombard Wars, Milan, Venice, Florence, and Naples agree at Lodi to a 25-year non-aggression pact mediated by Pope Nicholas V. The treaty recognises Francesco Sforza as Duke of Milan, defines a permanent Milanese-Venetian boundary at the Adda, and establishes a quintuple Italian League.

_quarry.structural_significance: Inaugurates 40 years of relative peace (the 'Italian Peace') that fuels the Renaissance's mature phase. Introduces resident diplomats as a permanent institution; ends with the French invasion of 1494 and the Italian Wars.
